arguments.command:
python -c "
import math

value = 1234
log_value = math.log10(abs(value))
power = int(log_value / 3) * 3
print(f'power = {power}')

prefixes = [
    (24, 'Y'),
    (21, 'Z'),
    (18, 'E'),
    (15, 'P'),
    (12, 'T'),
    (9, 'G'),
    (6, 'M'),
    (3, 'k'),
    (0, ''),
    (-3, 'm'),
    (-6, 'u'),
    (-9, 'n'),
    (-12, 'p'),
    (-15, 'f'),
    (-18, 'a'),
    (-21, 'z'),
    (-24, 'y'),
]

matched_prefix = ''
matched_power = 0
for p, prefix in reversed(prefixes):
    print(f'Checking p={p}, prefix={prefix!r} against power={power}')
    if p <= power:
        matched_prefix = prefix
        matched_power = p
        print(f'Matched: {prefix} with power {p}')
        break
"
